parts.title: Into the Green
parts.text: Santiago led the way along a muddy trail as the team entered the rainforest. The air was **humid**, so thick and wet that Bree's glasses fogged in seconds. Everything around them was **lush**, from giant ferns to vines wrapped around every trunk. Overhead, the **foliage** of the tallest trees blocked the sun. Kwame, the team's biologist, whispered that the canopy was **teeming** with life, with thousands of insects, birds and monkeys in every layer.

parts.title: Hidden Dangers
parts.text: Pushing through the thick **undergrowth**, the bushes and small plants beneath the trees, Bree nearly stepped on a snake. It was **venomous**, and its bite could be deadly, but its **camouflage** had hidden it so well that she saw it only when it moved. Kwame warned them to check for ticks, each a **parasite** that clings to skin and feeds on blood. Then a **swarm** of tiny bees circled their heads, and everyone froze until it drifted away.

parts.title: The Search
parts.text: The goal of the expedition was to photograph a rare golden frog that was **endangered**, with fewer than a hundred left in the wild. It was **elusive**, so hard to find that no scientist had seen one in five years. After two days of searching, the team reached a **tranquil** pool where the only sounds were dripping water and distant birdsong. There, sitting on a leaf, was the frog.

parts.title: What the Forest Rewards
parts.text: Santiago raised his camera slowly and took one perfect photograph. Bree realized that the forest rewarded patience and quiet eyes. On the long walk home, the team promised to share the picture so that more people would care about protecting this hidden world.

definitions.meaning1: Growing thickly and healthily, with plenty of green plants. Example: After the spring rains, the meadow was lush and green.

definitions.meaning1: Bushes, ferns and small plants growing beneath tall trees. Example: We pushed through the thick undergrowth to reach the stream.

definitions.meaning1: Colors or patterns that help an animal or object blend into its surroundings. Example: The green lizard's camouflage made it nearly invisible on the leaf.

definitions.meaning1: Hard to find, catch or keep track of. Example: The elusive snow leopard is rarely seen by humans.
definitions.meaning2: Hard to understand, remember or achieve. Example: The name of the song stayed elusive, no matter how hard she tried to recall it.

definitions.meaning1: In danger of dying out completely. Example: The giant panda was once listed as an endangered species.

definitions.meaning1: Calm, quiet and peaceful. Example: The tranquil lake was perfectly still at dawn.
